sources.title: 誠也の部屋【ひまわり -Pebble in the sky- PC版 攻略】
sources.notes: Set A; exact-target Japanese walkthrough for the 2016 Windows release r44665. Complete PC-remake walkthrough covering all four main routes, all nineteen bad/alternative endings, explicit saves/reloads, and post-clear material. Use this set for exact PC choice/save text. Complete 2016 PC remake walkthrough, updated 16/05/22: all four main routes, all nineteen bad/alternative endings, nineteen explicitly numbered source saves, reload references, and post-clear Another Side, 2048-2050, Tips and Keywords. Includes Vita trophy annotations; these are not choice text. Direct connections timed out, but the full page was successfully fetched using https://r.jina.ai/https://seiya-saiga.com/game/frontwing/himawari_pc.html, including an HTML response requested with X-Return-Format: html. Use the actual HTML for exact quotes: the default Markdown representation adds checkbox syntax that is not original source text. Source reload references are written as ◆セーブNN から; do not manufacture a verbatim load instruction where a source does not supply one. The source numbers are references, not final player save numbers after reordering detours.

sources.title: Vita　ひまわり -Pebble in the sky- 　攻略 | みずきのこのブログ
sources.notes: Set B; independent Japanese walkthrough for the immediately preceding 2015 PlayStation Vita remake r40151. It independently corroborates the same four-route unlock/order, route-defining branches, main endings, and nineteen non-main endings used by the Windows target. It is cross-platform structural/outcome evidence, not a source of exact Windows text: punctuation and harmless-choice divergences remain preserved verbatim in jpGuide2 rather than being normalized into Set A. Entire article fetched directly. Dated 2015/08/30; complete choice coverage for the four Vita-remake routes and nineteen bad/alternative endings, including the two-choice Aqua detours and an explicit shared SAVE/reload. Does not cover post-clear supplemental stories, Tips or Keywords, and does not explicitly mark most saves. Use with Seiya for remake-era route cross-validation; use Gorilla's supplemental pages for coverage absent here. Slash-separated alternatives and END labels are source formatting, not one combined game choice. Contains spelling/punctuation differences and some alternate harmless choices; preserve source quotes without silently normalizing them.

sources.title: ひまわり-PebbleintheSky-攻略wiki
sources.notes: Third complete Japanese main-route walkthrough, distributed across the four route pages listed below, plus ending inventory, Tips, Keywords and clear-bonus pages. Index retains PS2/PSP-era links and DX-pack information: its 2019 migration/update dates do not establish that it was written for the Vita remake. Use to cross-check shared branches, optional equivalent answers, delayed endings and bonus unlocks, while prioritizing the two remake-era primary guides for exact game text. Direct access returned 403; all listed pages were fetched through https://r.jina.ai/ followed by the original URL.

sources.title: 【ひまわり】攻略の手引き【Pebble in the Sky】
sources.notes: Explicit dependency evidence: Aries True End unlocks Restart; Akari True End unlocks Aqua; Aqua True End unlocks Asuka. Also describes returning to the preceding choice after a bad end. Does not require bad-end completion for the heroine unlock chain.

sources.title: 【ひまわり】アリエス【Pebble in the Sky】
sources.notes: Complete Aries branch listing. Notes that 部長を呼ぶ does not occur on the first run; documents delayed 夢の続き and 消えたアリエス, two answers leading to 煙雨, and equivalent final confrontation choices. States that red bold choices are recommended save points; the text-only fetch does not preserve red styling, so use Seiya's explicit save markers rather than inferring colors.

sources.title: 【ひまわり】Restart【Pebble in the Sky】
sources.notes: Complete one-decision Restart walkthrough; identifies 星乃 明香里 True End and 旅立ち. Independently corroborates both primary guides' branching.

sources.title: 【ひまわり】アクア【Pebble in the Sky】
sources.notes: Complete Aqua route and seven alternative endings. Particularly important independent evidence for the full two-decision 日向葵 and 摘出 paths. Explicitly confirms 上/中/下 and トレース・オン/今はまだ手の内を見せる時じゃない as equivalent alternatives.

sources.title: 【ひまわり】西園寺 明香【Pebble in the Sky】
sources.notes: Complete Asuka path and both bad endings. Explicitly confirms the equivalence of the three reassurance answers, the お父さん/センパイ/社長 answers, and the order-independent requirement to see all three late visits.

sources.title: 【ひまわり】エンディング【Pebble in the Sky】
sources.notes: Ending inventory corroborates four character True Ends, nineteen other endings and the three supplemental stories こもれび, かげろう and 2048-2050. Contains malformed legacy hyperlinks, but the ending names are readable. Confirms 日向葵 rather than Mizukinoko's 向日葵.

sources.title: 【ひまわり】クリア特典【Pebble in the Sky】
sources.notes: Set B completion component. Directly documents Story→Another Side and 2048-2050 after the fourth clear, identifies こもれび, and documents that clearing the first Another Side adds the new かげろう scenario. Also documents Tips updates and Story:Tips.

sources.title: 【ひまわり】Tips【Pebble in the Sky】
sources.notes: Set B completion component. Lists 三十六輪 and explicitly states `※「三十五輪」まで全て見ると追加される。`, independently supporting the completion section's reviewed terminal. Has an apparent typo 二一輪 in the position of twenty; preserve source text verbatim when quoted.

sources.title: 【ひまわり】キーワード【Pebble in the Sky】
sources.notes: Supplementary Keywords inventory. It does not independently state Set A's `Keywordsにひまわりが追加` unlock condition, so the reviewed completion section does not claim that Set-A-only terminal.

sources.title: プラチナさん6個目 ひまわり -Pebble in the Sky-(PSV) - Uranometria
sources.notes: Supplementary Vita platinum report dated 2016/01/18, fetched through r.jina.ai after direct access returned 429. Recommends the same four-route order while collecting bad ends, then reading unlocked material and opening Graphic/Music. Not a complete choice walkthrough and not a primary source. Its broad completion advice must not be mistaken for proof that every bad end gates the next heroine.

sources.title: Himawari | vndb
sources.notes: Release/version metadata, not an English walkthrough. Entire release list fetched directly. Latest official release listed is Windows r71939, 2020/05/20, a revised localization of Frontwing's Vita remake adding Simplified Chinese. Latest Japanese-text release listed is Windows r44665, 2016/02/12, itself a port of the 2015/08/27 Vita remake r40151. No Switch or PS4 release is listed or was found in the supplementary Japanese search. The 2022 Spanish entry is an unofficial translation patch, not evidence of newer story content. Target the latest remake content, not the 2007 original or separate Aqua After fandisc.

sources.title: Himawari -The Sunflower- | VNDB release r71939
sources.notes: Fetched through r.jina.ai. Explicitly supersedes the 2016/12/09 localization r41281 and describes the 2020/05/20 update as adding Simplified Chinese to the Vita-remake port. No additional heroine route is documented. This is the latest official content/version target; Japanese choice references must come from its Japanese remake counterpart because this localization lacks Japanese interface/subtitles.

sources.title: Himawari - The Sunflower - on Steam
sources.notes: Store page fetched with l=japanese. Lists English and Simplified Chinese interface/subtitles and Japanese voice only, and explicitly warns that Japanese is not supported as the display language. Store launch date is 2016/12/09; this is compatible with VNDB's separate 2020 localization-update date. Do not tell players that the Japanese simpleJp text appears verbatim in the Steam interface.

sources.title: ひまわり -Pebble in the Sky- 公式サイト
sources.notes: Official remake portal, retrieved through r.jina.ai. Links both Vita and Japanese Windows editions and identifies the Kuuchuu Yousai visual redesign. Version context, not a walkthrough.

sources.title: ひまわり -Pebble in the Sky- 製品情報
sources.notes: Official product specifications, fetched through r.jina.ai. Confirms Japanese Windows release 2016/02/12, full voice except special material, 960×544 resolution, and the Vita edition. Use the actual product date rather than older search results announcing a provisional February 5 date.

sources.title: ひまわり-Pebble in the Sky- 紹介 | PROTOTYPE
sources.notes: Official Vita introduction, fetched through r.jina.ai. Describes the 2007 original, 2010 PSP voice/graphics additions, and the 2015 Vita graphics overhaul, full voice and interface improvements. Does not advertise new heroine routes. Supplemental stories are nevertheless explicitly covered by the remake walkthrough and must not be omitted. The official index at http://www.prot.co.jp/psv/himawari/index.html was also fetched to locate this page.

sources.title: Himawari character list | vndb
sources.notes: Fetched directly and through r.jina.ai. Actual portrait URLs matched by name for Aries, Aqua and Asuka. The task's vv210/chars spelling is a malformed double-v URL; that URL was attempted, but v210/chars is the valid page. Default spoiler filtering omits Akari, so VNDB's API was additionally queried for all v210 characters; it identifies Akari without an image. Image IDs and character IDs differ: never synthesize portrait URLs from c-numbers.

sources.title: Hoshino Akari | vndb
sources.notes: Fetched through r.jina.ai; explicitly displays No image. VNDB API independently returns original name 星乃 明香里 and image null. Confirms that an empty portrait is intentional, not an unresolved match.
